ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patches situated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. The central region is dominated by low-intensity pixels containing a high density of mid-intensity circular mottled spots (blobs) distributed across the dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased prominence near the medial notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve originating from the peduncle and terminating in sharp, slightly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread distribution of circular, mid-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) across the dark pigmented areas; distinct high-contrast white textured clusters representing barnacle colonization on the distal leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) observed on the left lobe, including one prominent horizontal mark in the mid-ventral region and multiple diagonal rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) visible along the leading edges of both lobes, particularly heavy on the outer left margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy calcified biological growth extending beyond the anatomical edge of the fluke, creating a jagged, non-biological silhouette on the left and right tips.
